result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by a wide, multi-lane arterial road with minimal infrastructure. The lack of sidewalks in the immediate foreground and the long, unprotected crossing distances across the intersection present significant safety risks for people walking.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must traverse a very wide roadway with at least four travel lanes, increasing exposure to vehicle traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the center and right background

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Refuge
hazards.description: The absence of a median or refuge island means pedestrians have no safe place to wait if they cannot complete the crossing in one signal cycle.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the roadway to reduce exposure and allow for two-stage crossings.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Upgrade the existing parallel line markings to high-visibility continental markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions to reduce the crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is highly hostile, featuring a signalized intersection that lacks marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals. The existing sidewalk is in poor condition and partially obstructed by construction debris and fencing, forcing pedestrians into a wide roadway with high-speed potential.

hazards.name: Missing Pedestrian Crossing Infrastructure
hazards.description: The intersection lacks marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals, leaving pedestrians unprotected while crossing a wide multi-lane road.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction and Degradation
hazards.description: Debris and construction fencing significantly narrow or block the pedestrian path, creating tripping hazards and potential roadway incursions.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image along the construction site

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style high-visibility crosswalk markings on all legs of the intersection to define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signalization
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers and accessible push buttons to provide dedicated crossing phases.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Reconstruction and Clearance
interventions.description: Repair the damaged sidewalk surface and remove all construction debris to ensure a continuous, ADA-compliant path.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by a wide, multi-lane roadway with high-speed traffic and a lack of basic safety infrastructure such as marked crosswalks or pedestrian signals. A narrow sidewalk is present but is bordered by a large construction site, creating a hostile and exposed environment for anyone walking.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: Lack of marked crosswalks at a signalized intersection forces pedestrians to cross multiple lanes of traffic without clear guidance or priority.

hazards.name: Wide Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The roadway consists of four or more lanes, requiring pedestrians to cover a significant distance without a refuge island.

hazards.name: High-Speed Traffic Environment
hazards.description: The wide lane widths and lack of traffic calming measures encourage high vehicle speeds.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian paths and increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Construct a raised median or refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide roadway in two stages.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on crossing time.

result.summary: The environment is highly car-oriented with a wide multi-lane roadway and minimal pedestrian infrastructure. Despite the presence of traffic signals, there are no marked crosswalks or pedestrian signals visible, forcing pedestrians to cross a wide expanse of asphalt unprotected.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at this signalized intersection, leaving pedestrians without a designated path.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the foreground

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide multi-lane road requires a long time to cross without any refuge islands.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No pedestrian-specific signal heads are visible to indicate when it is safe to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: On the traffic signal poles at the right
